6.102 rsInvalidRowGrouping
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsInvalidRowGrouping is a critical error that will occur if a RowGrouping element contains both or
neither of the following: RowGrouping.StaticRows and RowGrouping.DynamicRows.
